name: 男士绵密泡沫温和洁面乳款
description: 深蓝铜金男士视觉体系，绵密泡沫温和清洁，洗后水润不紧绷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep ink-navy #2C3A4E and slate blue #5A6E82 infographic panels with clean white #FFFFFF packshot breaks
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio lighting, gentle key from the upper left, controlled soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy round podium with brushed copper-gold trim, matte dark panels, light grey-stone counter
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline badges and numbered circles, single light stroke
styleLock.presentationRules: upright tube with flip cap at the base, stable scale and centering across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent masculine skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep ink-navy #2C3A4E, slate blue #5A6E82, clean white #FFFFFF and one copper-gold accent #C9A063; cool soft studio lighting with a gentle key from the upper left and controlled soft contact shadows; modern bold geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular outline icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic cards; upright tube product presented at a stable scale with the flip cap at the base; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索首屏一眼锁定男士洁面定位，建立深蓝铜金调性
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, tube standing upright and centered
shots.lighting: cool soft studio key from the upper left, controlled soft contact shadow
shots.props: two thin copper-gold ring arcs and a few falling green leaves kept at the frame edges
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper third for the headline
shots.textZone: upper third headline zone for 「{selling_point_1}」 and a short subline 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: Product hero shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed straight-on at eye level with the tube standing upright and centered, full product visible. Cool soft studio key light from the upper left with a controlled soft contact shadow grounding the tube. Seamless deep ink-navy background panel #2C3A4E, with two thin copper-gold ring arcs and a few falling green leaves kept at the frame edges, never overlapping the product. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space in the upper third. Render a headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a short subline 「{selling_point_2}」 in the upper third, in modern bold geometric sans-serif. Negative: no brand logos or wordmarks, no invented efficacy claims, no QR codes, no watermark, no harsh specular blowout on the tube shoulder, no props overlapping the product, no garbled text.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：p1 深墨蓝底金环绿叶背景的白色软管洁面乳主视觉；p2-p3 深蓝痛点版列编号卡片（出油旺盛、痘痘频发等，且编号3的中文标题与英文标注自相矛盾，均不采信）；p4 软管特写配洁净、控油祛痘、提亮肤色、补水保湿四个细线圆环徽标；p5 白底掌心绵密泡沫特写并标注弱酸性适合男性肤质；p6-p7 三张绿植微距成分卡片（具体成分名与功效描述不采信，仅保留卡片结构）；p7-p8 软管配天然精华、先进技术、安全保障深色信息卡（三卡文字为重复填充，不采信）；p8-p9 三步使用手法01/02/03；p9-p10 金框授权证书与检测报告版面、产品信息表（品牌名为占位字样、型号与容量数值不采信）、角落会员角标与二维码。品类判定：p10 参数表品名为男士洗面奶，p9 使用步骤均针对脸部清洁，p4 徽标均为面部护理诉求，故判为护肤个护/面部护理，leaf 取男士绵密泡沫洁面乳，与源夹名洗护不矛盾但以图内硬证据为准。已剥离：品牌字样与LOGO、证书与检测报告版面、会员角标与二维码、原文案原句、容量与型号等规格数值、祛痘美白类功效断言；成分卡片改为空文本行占位，证书改为空白证框；人像仅保留手部与掌心泡沫；产品一律以{product}占位。
